title: Staff Security DevOps Engineer
searchText: Staff Security DevOps Engineer Fivetran  From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About the Role Fivetran is seeking a Staff Security DevOps Engineer to bolster and improve the robustness and security of the Fivetran Platform. This individual contributor (IC) role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring deep expertise in container security, Kubernetes infrastructure, secure DevOps practices, and Java application deployment. You will work closely with engineering teams to build, optimize, and secure our development and deployment pipelines, automate infrastructure processes, and ensure robust, secure, and scalable systems. This is a full-time, hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. Technologies You’ll Use Scripting Languages(Python, Go, Bash), Java, IaC(Terraform), Github, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Platform(AWS, GCP & Azure), Build Tools(Maven, Buildkite, NPM), Container Technology (Docker, Kubernetes). What You'll Do Build, optimize, and maintain secure and efficient Docker images, with a strong focus on Java-based applications. Debug, tune, and secure Java applications across development and production environments, partnering with developers to optimize runtime performance and minimize risk. Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) configurations to streamline and secure Kubernetes deployments. Configure, run, and debug Kubernetes clusters across multiple cloud service providers, proactively identifying performance and security improvements. Collaborate with engineering teams to build scalable, reliable, and secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating automated testing, scanning, and monitoring throughout the development lifecycle. Perform advanced networking configuration and troubleshooting across cloud environments, implementing least-privilege access and network segmentation policies. Work directly with developers and infrastructure teams to integrate secure deployment practices and remediate risks in build pipelines and runtime environments. Contribute to vulnerability and misconfiguration detection in container images, Java application dependencies, and infrastructure components, automating detection and response workflows. Collaborate with infrastructure and engineering teams to implement consistent security controls, monitoring, and alerting across Fivetran Platform. Contribute to broader security initiatives, including threat and risk assessments, architecture reviews, incident response, compliance support, and internal tooling improvements. Stay up to date with container security, Kubernetes advancements, Container trends, and Java application security, applying knowledge to improve operational efficiency and security posture. Skills We're Looking For Deep expertise in Docker image creation, optimization, and vulnerability mitigation, particularly for Java applications. Experienced in working across all three major cloud providers—AWS, GCP, and Azure—with a deep understanding of their respective services, security models, and deployment patterns. Extensive experience with Kubernetes: deploying, running, debugging, securing, and performance tuning in production environments. Senior-level experience with Java codebases: building, running, profiling, and optimizing Java applications in secure environments. Strong understanding of cloud-native networking, ingress controllers, service meshes, and firewall configurations. Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, Helm, or Ansible for managing infrastructure at scale. Proficiency in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Bash, Python, Go) to automate processes and integrate tools. Familiarity with Security tooling for CI/CD security, container scanning, dependency analysis, and infrastructure compliance. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments. Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate across engineering, infrastructure, and security teams. Demonstrates strong curiosity, a sense of urgency, and a hands-on approach to diving deep into complex technical problems to drive timely and effective solutions. #LI-HYBRID #LI-AM1 The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Oakland Pay Range $196,033 — $245,041.50 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays, and volunteer days off RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.
